source.title: Natural Earth 5.1.1 Admin-1 States and Provinces

method: Each existing canonical IDN Polygon component was intersected with Papua and West Papua Admin-1 union using Shapely 2.1.2. Selected components all have 100% overlap and a representative point contained in the union. Original coordinates and ring ordering are preserved; no clipping or geometries are invented.
notes: The mask removes western New Guinea and islands of its two Natural Earth v5.1.1 provinces before 1963-05-01; it does not remove the geographically nearby Aru, Tanimbar or Maluku islands.
An administrative reference mask is not a historical cadastral boundary: the result is an explicitly approximate political-territory visualization.
See 1962 New York Agreement and UNTEA transfer account for timing.
